question: In March 2025, where was the main event of the 56th Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) Raising Day celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thakkolam, Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The main event of the 56th Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) Raising Day was celebrated on **March 10, 2025**, in **Thakkolam, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• This marked the first time the CISF Raising Day celebration was held in Tamil Nadu, showcasing the force's commitment to pan-India visibility.
 
• The event highlighted CISF’s pivotal role in securing critical infrastructure and industries across the nation.
 
• Key dignitaries, including senior officials from the Ministry of Home Affairs and state government representatives, attended the celebration.
 
• The CISF demonstrated its operational excellence through parades, exhibitions, and drills as part of the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Industrial Security Force (CISF):**

 
 
• Established in **1969**, CISF is one of the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) of India.
 
• The force provides security to critical infrastructure such as airports, metro systems, government buildings, and industrial establishments.
 
• It operates under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
 
 
• **Raising Day Significance:**
 
 
• The CISF Raising Day commemorates the formation of the force and serves as an occasion to honor its contributions to national security.
 
• The event fosters morale and public awareness regarding the role of CISF in safeguarding the nation.
 
 
 
• **CISF Deployment:**
 
 
• CISF is deployed across a wide array of sectors, including power plants, space organizations, and ports.
 
• It also provides security to VIPs and disaster management services during emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Regional Celebrations:**
 
 
• Hosting the event in different regions promotes inclusivity and emphasizes the nationwide presence of CISF.
 
• The 2025 event in Tamil Nadu highlighted the southern region's importance in industrial and infrastructural growth.
